findings.title: Projection reuse keyed only on Generation may serve stale cells
findings.message: The fast path skips Snapshot, re-validation and cell placement whenever the generation number matches. The state is read from r.node.Grid, while the cached projection came from g.model. If either the descriptor's Grid or the model's viewport, config or selection can change without a generation bump, stale cells are kept. The same holds if a different model with an equal generation is bound to the record. A generation collision across models would silently show the old projection.
findings.suggestion: Also require that state came from the same model, for example by comparing the *virtual.Grid pointer with g.model. Alternatively, compare a stamp that includes the viewport and config. Add a regression test where a different model with the same generation is swapped in.
